description_en: Queries the trend of queries per second (QPS)
description_zh: 查看请求命中的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-peak-trend --start-timestamp 1665331200 --end-timestamp 1665386340 --interval 300 --resource www.aliyundoc.com --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePeakTrend

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used as the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The time interval. Unit: seconds. The value must be an integer multiple of 60
parameters.help_zh: 时间间隔，单位：秒。取值为60的整数倍
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The protected object for which you want to query the QPS trend, such as a domain name
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
